title: Expand a Binomial
prompt:
Expand the product into a polynomial in standard form:

    (x − 3)(x + 2)

Any algebraically-equivalent form is accepted — the symbolic pipeline checks equivalence, not spelling.
hint: use ^ for powers and * for products, e.g. x^2 - x - 6  (implicit 2x and (..)(..) also work)
recap: To expand (x + a)(x + b), distribute every pair (FOIL): x^2 + (a + b)x + ab. The linear coefficient is the sum of a and b; the constant is their product.
